# Source

This fixture preserves the dynamic service and port maps used by OctoPrint with TrueCharts common 29.7.1. It also preserves the service checksum and the truth check on the default main port.

Upstream chart: <https://github.com/truecharts/public/tree/master/charts/stable/octoprint>

Upstream common library: <https://github.com/truecharts/library-charts>

Upstream license: BSD-3-Clause.
